subject: Field route matrix: flight lift & overnight backfill
messages:
From: CloudExpo Ops <ops@cloudexpo.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, eve.sanders@aconex.ai
Cc: ops_team@cloudexpo.co
Date: 2027-07-19T15:04:00Z
Subject: Venue access window + last-mile lodging ask

Hi Soojin and Eve,

Quick update from the venue: load-in is now 06:00-09:00 on Monday due to stage setup adjustments. This compresses our on-site windows and impacts the shuttle schedule we scoped. Two asks from our side:

1) Final manifest for arrivals on Sunday night and early Monday morning (who needs hotel nights and who is local).
2) Any staff that can absorb an extra overnight on Sunday and cover the 05:30 run to the venue.

We still have the Lodgings Plus hotel block but need to reduce 6 rooms to 3 by end of day Monday or the block fee applies. Could you confirm who must be booked?

Also looping Delta group for a mass rebook option if flights need to be moved to Sunday evening.

Thanks,
Sam (on behalf of CloudExpo Ops)
attachments: venue_floorplan.pdf (image), initial_shuttle_plan.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: ops@cloudexpo.co, eve.sanders@aconex.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-19T18:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Venue access window + last-mile lodging ask

Thanks Sam 

Copied the on-site team. Quick internal assessment below.

Summary of gaps we have after checking current bookings:
- 4 reps arriving Saturday night (no change)
- 5 reps arriving Sunday afternoon (2 of these are local contractors who can do the 05:30 run)
- 3 reps currently booked for Monday morning flights that would miss load-in if unchanged

Proposed immediate actions (please approve):
- Convert 2 of the Sunday arrivals to Sunday night stays (covering the shuttle at 05:30). Marissa and Connor, can you absorb one extra overnight each?
- Rebook 2 of the Monday morning flights to Sunday evening (request Delta mass rebook option). If Delta confirms waiver, we shift 3 people to Sunday nights.
- Reduce hotel block by 3 rooms (we keep 6).

I attached a working matrix with who is tentatively flexible. If we get the rebook confirmation, I'll finalize hotel names and send the manifest.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
attachments: field_shift_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: ops@cloudexpo.co
Date: 2027-07-20T09:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Venue access window + last-mile lodging ask

On Tue, Jul 19, 2027 at 18:20 Soojin Lee wrote:
> I attached a working matrix with who is tentatively flexible.

I can take an extra night Sunday. I already land Saturday night so staying on Sunday is fine. I will cover the early shuttle if needed.

Also flagged that one of my flights is refundable for a small fee; Connor, can you confirm the final headcount and I will submit my expense if we need to swap to Sunday evening?

Attaching updated flight manifest with the tentative rebook candidates noted.

- Marissa
attachments: flight_manifest_v2.csv (csv)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ops@cloudexpo.co
Date: 2027-07-20T12:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Venue access window + last-mile lodging ask

Thanks team. I took Soojin's matrix and split the hotel plan into two properties to reduce the block fee exposure: 3 rooms at Lodgings Plus (walking distance) and 3 rooms at The Harbor Inn (shuttle). Shuttle plan below:

- 05:00 depart Lodgings Plus (3 reps)
- 05:10 depart The Harbor Inn (3 reps + equipment)
- 05:35 arrive venue service entrance

If Delta provides a mass rebook waiver we move 3 additional people to Sunday night and cancel 3 Harbor Inn rooms.

Sheet with the rooming list and shuttle pickup order: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcRouteMatrix/edit#gid=0

Connor
Field Ops Coordinator | Redwood Inference

From: Delta Air Group <group@deltaair.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: ops@cloudexpo.co
Date: 2027-07-21T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Mass rebook option for CloudExpo group

Hi Soojin and team,

We can offer a one-time mass re-accommodation for your group under fare-waiver EXPO2027. This permits moves from Monday morning flights to Sunday evening without change fees; any fare difference applies. To proceed we need a passenger manifest by 18:00 ET today and credit card details for fare differences.

Please send the manifest as CSV and confirm which 3 names to move.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Group Services | Delta Air Group
attachments: delta_mass_rebook_terms.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: ops@cloudexpo.co, marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: lodgingsplus@lodgingsplus.com, eve.sanders@aconex.ai
Date: 2027-07-21T21:30:00Z
Subject: Final manifest + hotel block confirm

Team,

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Delta's confirmation we moved 3 pax to Sunday evening: Marissa Cole, Julian Park (contractor), and Priya Natarajan. Connor, please send the CSV manifest to Delta under EXPO2027 waiver and include the card for fare diffs.

Hotel update: Keeping Lodgings Plus 3 rooms and canceling 3 rooms at The Harbor Inn to avoid the block fee. Lodgings Plus sent the attached confirmation and will invoice the block penalty if we miss the cancellation window (we met it).

Shuttle plan stands as Connor outlined. Rishi, please confirm you have the early equipment checklist and badge pickup order for the 05:35 arrival.

Attachments: hotel_block_confirm.pdf (pdf), field_shift_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Soojin Lee
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
